turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Heatwave this week, and my mum is eighty four and lives alone. I'm worried.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a good thing to worry about. Older people often don't feel thirsty and can overheat without noticing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She refuses to turn the fan on, she says it's wasteful.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Explain it's just for this week. Curtains closed in the day and windows open at night really help too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. My partner and I want to plan a nice Sunday together, help me choose.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Please wait until I've gone through all the options.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is a long brunch at that new place by the river, followed by a walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a cooking class in the afternoon where we'd make fresh pasta together.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could go to the art museum, which has a new exhibit opening this week.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What does your partner usually enjoy more, food or culture? If it's food, the cooking class is a great pick. You could even do the river walk after the museum.
